about_the_game:
In this cozy bakery sim, you'll serve "particular" customers (wink!

You love documenting everything! Every bread's recipe, every customer's preferences become warm diary entries with pictures.

Demo Content

In the trial version, you will experience levels 1-10 of the game, unlock at least 8 customers, at least 13 types of bread, and obtain some stickers.

Full Version Features

🍞Realistic Simulation: Read customers' needs, pick correct breads before they get impatient

🧺 Satisfying Organization: Grid system for aesthetic & efficient placement

🥐 60+ Breads: Discover global varieties with authentic ingredients

🎁 Gift Boxing: Pack 3 breads for special stickers!

🧩 Puzzle Solving:Complete puzzles to unlock secret bread recipes

👥 Diverse Customers: Unlock stories and build friendships!

🎶 Charming Music: Relaxing melodies to brighten your day

short_description: Delightful bakery sim demo! Play levels 1-10: discover features, 13+ breads & 8+ customer stories. Collect stickers! As a caring baker, satisfy every request—strawberry, chocolate, whole wheat, nuts... master all flavors! Try now!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
